summary.text: Myron Dorn is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 30, and was elected in 2018 and re-elected in 2022, according to the Legislature's biography.
The Legislature lists Myron Dorn's occupation as a farmer.

paragraphs.text: Myron Dorn was born on October 23, 1954, in Beatrice.
Myron Dorn graduated from Adams High School in 1972 and earned a B.S. from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln in 1976.
Myron Dorn served on the Gage County Board from 2010 to 2018, including as its chairman.
Myron Dorn has been an EMT with the Adams Rescue Squad since 1986.
Myron Dorn married Julie Salomons on December 1, 1979, and they have two children.
